applications ( Linux, also R/T, e.g. Yocto, Windows, Office, Confluence, Git, Jira, Gerrit, Doxygen, Doors, Polyspace )\- Profound experience in development for bare-metal targets w/o memory protection\- Programming language skills : C/C++, Assembler ( SPARC, ARM, .. )\- Experience with Multi-Core Embedded CPUs ( e.g. ARM, SPARC )\- Mastering the GNU compile environmentNon-technical:\- jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.109220 | Asset & Investment Management | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | TemporaryThe Private Markets Solutions Team designs and manages diversified private markets portfolios across bespoke mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives and market views into allocation, portfolio construction and investment decisions. Working across private equity, private debt, infrastructure, and selectively real estate, the team partners with specialist investment teams to access their deal flow in primaries, co-investments and secondaries while also investing in the platform's direct strategies and performing selective, complementary sourcing. The team retains end-to-end responsibility for portfolio strategy, pacing, investment decisions and ongoing portfolio steering. The team is part of risklab, the solutions pillar of Allianz Global Investors' global investment platform, and works closely with other risklab teams, on modelling of private markets, strategic asset allocation advice, and holistic public-private portfolios.The Portfolio Analyst supports the construction and ongoing management of diversified private markets mandates and evergreen funds through portfolio analysis, investment monitoring, pacing and liquidity modelling, and preparation of investment decisions. Working across asset classes and alongside experienced portfolio managers, the role offers broad exposure to the full portfolio lifecycle and a clear path toward increasing investment responsibility.What you will do- Produce portfolio, exposure, diversification, performance and scenario analyses- Maintain pacing, commitment, cash-flow and liquidity models- Monitor portfolios against investment guidelines, allocation targets and risk limits- Analyse investment opportunities and prepare materials for portfolio reviews and investment committees- Coordinate portfolio data and inputs from specialist investment teams, operations and reporting functions- Improve analytical tools, dashboards and investment processes, while gradually taking ownership of defined workstreamsWhat you bring- Master's degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, business administration or another quantitative discipline; additional investment qualifications are an advantage.- Up to 3 years of relevant experience in private markets, portfolio management, portfolio analytics, transaction services or investment consulting is an advantage.- Good understanding of investment and portfolio management concepts; initial knowledge of private markets strongly preferred.- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including financial modelling, cash-flow analysis and interpretation of portfolio data.- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with data-analysis or visualisation tools is an advantage.- Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, decision-relevant conclusions and materials.- Structured and reliable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.- Flexible and self-reliant, with the ability to take ownership, adapt to changing priorities and proactively drive assigned work forward.- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across investment teams, asset classes and functions.- Fluent verbal and written skills in both English and German required.- Experience with Data Analytics, Data Modelling and Microsoft CoPilot.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- … and so much more!

Dermaliq is a private clinical stage specialty pharmaceutical company focusing on dermatology. Our mission is to develop breakthrough topical skin care products based on hyliQ®, a unique, validated and proprietary enabling technology platform. More on www.dermaliq.com.The skin is one of the body’s strongest protective barriers. We want you to help us cross it to treat severe, inherited skin diseases effectively and safely.We are expanding our research and development activities and are looking for aSenior Scientific Lead, Early Development - Topical Nucleic Acid Therapy m/f/dFor our progressing R&D program of topical nucleic acid skin therapies we are looking for a passionate scientist who enjoys pushing topical skin therapy boundaries to new frontiers with scientific excellence and dedication for topical gene therapies.Advance science. Develop nucleic acid-based technologies from early research towards candidates for topical dermatology, bringing in your own ideas and scientific concepts into proof-of-concept.Prove feasibility. Translate early nucleic acid-based formulation technologies into functional and cell-based assays to demonstrate technical feasibility and clinical relevance. Design pre-clinical models and studies, and interpret and present your data to peers and experts.Drive the work with our partners. Own your projects starting with epidermolysis bullosa (EB) with operational excellence and full budget accountability, including the selection, recommendation and management of external research organizations, ensuring high-quality execution and scientific rigor.Shape the direction. Help define the development strategy, present results and recommendations to management, and take the opportunity to build a team as the program evolves.PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry or similar.Several years of relevant experience in nucleic acid therapeutics within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.Deep expertise in nucleic acid-based technologies such as siRNA, ASO, and/or mRNA.Hands-on experience in nucleic-acid delivery system for cellular and tissue targeting including in-vitro, ex-vivo, functional or cell-based assays.Experience with nanoparticle-based drug delivery platforms (e.g. LNPs).Track record in running early development projects.Experience in managing external partners, e.g. external research providers, CROs.Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to present complex science convincingly to cross-functional teams, governance committees, and company stakeholders.We are highly innovative and act within the international biotech environment with a strong scientific foundation, patient focus and a promising and growing product pipeline in dermatology.You will work with a high degree of independence within a bigger team, shape the scientific direction, and see your own ideas turn into results.

jobs.occupation: Product Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Cyber Defense Operations (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Apply NowProduct Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Cyber Defense OperationsDate: 10/08/2026Company: SAPWe help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.Summary & Role Information:Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.What You'll Do:- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.What You Bring:Technical Foundation- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.Core AI Skills- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.Professional Skills- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.​Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management.
